top_signals.title: Virginia enacts first US data center electricity tax at $0.011/kWh -- self-generated SOFC power not exempt
top_signals.body: Effective July 1, 2026. Applies to ALL data center electricity including self-generated and behind-the-meter power. 500 MW SOFC in Virginia: ~$48M/year. Cap $600M/year through June 30, 2028. Northern Virginia (~70% of US colo capacity). SOFC grid-bypass value proposition materially reduced in the world's largest DC market.

top_signals.title: EFCF post-conference blackout extends to day 9-10 -- journal embargo threshold arrives Monday July 14
top_signals.body: 17th EFCF closed July 3 in Lucerne. No results from Elcogen (E3000 G2: >=75% elec / >=90% CHP at 650C), Ceres, SolydEra, or Convion. Sites still dark. Embargo threshold flagged in July 11 digest arrives Monday.
